localChanges: Press and drag anywhere on the map to pan it; let go mid-drag and it glides to a stop, and pressing again catches it. A quick click still centres on a tile or opens a city or unit, and a long press still opens the unit's actions.
Selecting a unit near the edge of the map now brings it back to the middle, rather than waiting until it is off-screen. How close counts as "near" is a new setting under Options (#14).
